### Profiles

The following profiles have been defined for this implementation guide.

These profiles define the constraints common to all value sets and code systems **authored by HL7 Australia**. They apply to FHIR R4 `ValueSet` and `CodeSystem` resources only; `ConceptMap` and `NamingSystem` are not yet in scope. Reference terminologies such as SNOMED CT-AU and LOINC are referenced by AU value sets, never republished by them, and are out of scope.

Both profiles encode the **common-ground floor only**: the metadata and structure that current AU practice already follows universally. They add no governance or lifecycle metadata.

The profiles are intended to be usable by any HL7 Australia implementation guide that publishes terminology resources. Whether an existing guide adopts them, by having its value sets and code systems declare conformance, is a decision for the work group that owns that guide.

Every constraint was measured against the published packages **AU Base 6.0.0**, **AU Core 2.0.0** and **AU eRequesting 1.0.0** before being written, and the generated profiles were then checked back against those same resources: **46 of the 47 AU-authored resources conform** (30/30 value sets, 16/17 code systems). That is a targeted check of the differential constraints (cardinality, fixed values, the jurisdiction pattern, the OID format), not a full FHIR validation.

The exception is the AU Base [Resource Tag](https://hl7.org.au/fhir/CodeSystem-resource-tag.html) code system, whose identifier `urn:oid:22.16.840.1.113883.2.3.4.1.4.35` is not a valid OID (the first arc of an OID is 0, 1 or 2). This is corrected to `2.16.840.1.113883.2.3.4.1.4.35` from AU Base 7.0.0-ballot1.
